val.english: What Taxi Drivers Say About Us

Welcome to Taxiterminalen - your association for taxi drivers and advice on cheap electricity contracts, insurance and pension agreements. We specialize in bringing taxi drivers together and ensuring better conditions for our members.
val.da: Velkommen til Taxiterminalen - din forening for taxachauffører og rådgivning om billige elaftaler, forsikrings- og pensionsaftaler. Vi er specialiserede i at samle taxachauffører og sikre bedre vilkår for vores medlemmer.

val.english: Better pension agreements for truckers and drivers

val.english: We offer professional advice and assistance in setting up a taxi business, as well as advantages on electricity contracts, insurance and pension agreements for our members. We bring taxi drivers together and ensure better conditions for the entire industry.
val.da: Vi tilbyder professionel rådgivning og bistand til etablering af taxavirksomhed samt fordele på elaftaler, forsikring og pension for vores medlemmer. Vi samler taxachauffører og sikrer bedre vilkår for branchen.

val.english: Strengthening the taxi industry, one driver at a time.
val.da: Styrker taxabranchen, én chauffør ad gangen.

val.english: We are a professional taxi association that offers advice and the creation of cheap electricity contracts, cheaper insurance and better pension agreements for our members. We also work to bring taxi drivers together to strengthen the industry.
val.da: Vi er en professionel taxiforening, der tilbyder rådgivning og oprettelse af billige elaftaler, billigere forsikringer og bedre pensionsaftaler for vores medlemmer. Vi arbejder også for at samle taxachauffører for at styrke branchen.

val.english: We are a taxi association that specializes in helping taxi drivers achieve better agreements and savings on electricity and insurance, as well as bringing them together to strengthen their business.
val.da: Vi er en taxiforening, der specialiserer sig i at hjælpe taxachauffører med at opnå bedre aftaler og besparelser på el og forsikring, samt bringe dem sammen for at styrke deres virksomhed.

val.english: Dear customers, Are you tired of having to pay a fortune for your taxi rides? Do you miss a better pension agreement and cheaper insurance as a taxi driver? Then read on! We are proud to present Taxiterminalen.dk - your new and improved solution for all your taxi needs.
val.da: Kære kunder, Er I trætte af at skulle betale en formue for jeres taxature? Savner du en bedre pensionsaftale og billigere forsikring som taxachauffør? Så læs videre! Vi er stolte af at præsentere Taxiterminalen.dk - din nye og forbedrede løsning til alle dine taxibehov.
